title: Docs: update pricing/packaging for AWS/GCP Marketplace SKUs + procurement FAQ
author: Elliot Price
release_notes:
- Updated Pricing & Packaging docs to reference AWS/GCP Marketplace SKUs and naming.
- Added procurement-oriented FAQ (billing, invoicing, upgrades/downgrades, refunds, support).
- Added links to marketplace onboarding pages and security FAQ with reviewed wording.
description: Context: As part of the Cloud Marketplace listing refresh, we need the public docs site to reflect the new Marketplace SKU taxonomy and answer procurement questions that currently bounce between Sales/SE/Support. This PR updates the pricing/packaging pages to reference AWS/GCP Marketplace availability (without duplicating marketplace listing copy), adds a procurement-oriented FAQ section, and aligns security/compliance wording to the reviewed language in the marketplace security FAQ. Scope: (1) Pricing & Packaging: add a Marketplace section that maps “Hosted API / Dedicated / Private” to Marketplace purchase paths, introduces add-ons as Marketplace line items where applicable (Compliance Pack, Extended Observability Retention, Premium SLA), and clarifies that exact pricing/terms are governed by the relevant Marketplace listing; avoid publishing discounting guidance. (2) FAQ: new “Buying via AWS/GCP Marketplace” FAQ covering: who can buy (buyer vs user roles), what the purchase enables (entitlements in Redwood org), how invoicing/committed spend works, how renewals happen, upgrades/downgrades policy at a high level, refunds/cancellations (direct to Marketplace), and how to reach Support for provisioning issues. (3) Link hygiene: add cross-links to the dedicated AWS and GCP Marketplace onboarding pages, and to the Security FAQ (SOC 2 report availability under NDA, encryption, audit logs, data retention/residency statements) with consistent disclaimers. Notes: No changes to product behavior; this is documentation-only but reviewed for claim accuracy. Screenshots intentionally omitted here; those live on the onboarding pages to reduce drift. Follow-ups: once listings are approved, we should replace the placeholder “See listing for regional availability” with the final region matrix if we decide to publish it in docs.

review_conversation: Soojin Lee: Requesting copy alignment with the listing messaging framework—avoid “guaranteed savings” language; also can we keep the SKU names exactly consistent with the marketplace taxonomy (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) and list add-ons as “Compliance Pack” and “Extended Retention” (not “Compliance Add-on”). Elliot Price: Updated wording to remove implied cost claims, and normalized SKU/add-on names to match the packaging proposal. Naomi Feldman: In FAQ, please clarify shared responsibility and avoid implying SOC 2 report is publicly downloadable. Elliot Price: Added the standard disclaimer block: ‘SOC 2 Type II report available upon request under NDA’ and added shared responsibility bullet (customer config + prompt/content responsibilities). Marcus Lin: Security wording nit—don’t say ‘end-to-end encryption’; say ‘encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest’, and be precise about KMS (‘cloud KMS integration’ rather than ‘customer-managed keys everywhere’). Elliot Price: Fixed. Also removed a sentence about ‘HSM-backed keys’ that isn’t universally true across deployment modes. Markus Klein: FAQ needs a direct answer on upgrades/downgrades—field keeps getting asked. Suggest: ‘Contact Support/Sales; changes are applied by updating entitlements; timing depends on marketplace.’ Elliot Price: Added an upgrades/downgrades entry and pointed to Support with expectations on timing + that refunds/credits follow marketplace policies. Camila Reyes: Looks good; ensure nav placement doesn’t bury this. Approved. Final: All requested changes addressed; CI green; merged via squash.
